# Pi source cohort with 50 agents

The `pinned-pi-6e284871` pilot started at 11:39:34 PM PST on November 19, 2026, with
the Git pin `8f92e68fbd49207804bf5503a7fb427ab3d5d192`. Pi 1.5.2 ran on host-a (17 workers),
host-e (17 workers), and host-f (16 workers). All workers routed inference to
host-a. Their first prompts fell within 1084 ms on the worker clocks.
All 50 sessions overlapped for 12.72 seconds.

The agents implemented Python policy functions in isolated qualification
workspaces. They published 48 changed source files across two windows of 25
assignments. The windows released verified terminal branch freezes before
the next publication window. The two conflict repairs kept the syntax tree
of the function the other agent had already merged. A bounded interpreter
verified the actual final source with 8,450 assertions.
All first coding attempts passed.

## Controller recovery and source conflicts

The initial controller stopped after a live reassignment was accepted.
A fresh checkout from the same Git revision on the management host
loaded the private lab profile and journal from a separate working
directory. It adopted the same claim from the broker after one submission.
It stopped again after removing the temporary worker directory on
host-a. The final attempt detected the removal and completed cleanup.
Exit codes were 74, 74, and 0.

## Integration and final state

The 100latent sandbox recorded 56 successful PR checks, 50 native merges
with exact verified Git and Actions receipts, and six ownership retirements.
All six old attempts were denied for publication and registration. The
Actions-only rule stayed in force, with no bypass actors or manual commit
statuses. Native queue capacity returned to one.

The audited main commit was `57910ab4cf28b8807a627f8ffdd23dc75a0bc3c8`.
`git fsck --full --strict` passed. Cleanup restored both broker configs
and the original rulesets, denied all 50 temporary identities, and removed
the three temporary worker directories. The native queue was empty and the
broker was healthy.

The 161 broker and pilot regression tests passed on macOS, Linux x86-64
on host-a, and Linux arm64 on host-e and host-f. Implementation commit
`01b750d` stays on the MIT baseline and uses post-MIT upstream only as
a black box. The follow-up at `626a79f` also passed four adapter
tests on each platform, including rejection of a different adapter type.
